items.headline: Al Hilal advances to AFC Champions League Elite quarter-finals

items.headline: Saudi Football Federation unveils Vision 2034 football development roadmap
items.summary: The SFF announced a comprehensive plan to develop grassroots football across all 13 Saudi regions ahead of the 2034 World Cup.
